title: isotrema heterophyllum
intro: Isotrema heterophyllum, commonly known as the Himalayan yew, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Isotrema heterophyllum include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and the potential to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
